verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the S&E API's single mention that it can "Manage transactions & reimbursements," so reimbursements are a documented capability but described in one line only. Payment-status, ACH and webhook items cover AP vendor payments, not employee reimbursements, and are not credited. Missing for 10: an employee out-of-pocket expense submission flow, reimbursement by direct deposit, any payout timeline ("in days"), status tracking from submission to payout, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an employee, I can submit an out-of-pocket expense and get reimbursed by direct deposit in days, tracked from submission to payout
